With original R21 Noto CJK fonts restored, strict <0.5% cross-CI high-threshold pixel parity still failed near boundary. Across-CI raster/font/antialias differences are not sufficient to invalidate same-session native material A/B.

sourceTrueNative3FrameMeasurement.ROI: x0:0 y0:80 x1:1005 y1:705; any RGB channel abs difference >1, >10, >25 is visual delta, NOT subjective quality score

frames.actualVisualAssessment: Genuine research maritime shade makes broad gray cargo hall roof much lighter, overdominant in left source view. Three-beat harbor world depth is not improved.
Control-tower scene changes minimally, does not improve real source port material silhouette or B51 perception.
True source R8J turbine/near-miss cue preserved but harbor water response hardly visible; source visuals remain low-fidelity.

sourceTrueNative3FrameMeasurement.imageProvenance: 9 real source Chromium PNGs, one session, original native source camera; not user photo, not synthetic image generation
sourceTrueNative3FrameMeasurement.crossCIOriginalRawPixelIdentity: Not guaranteed across CI runs; recorded separately; at 65.25/66.35 >25 0%, 68.05 .313%. Not conflated with within-run controlled A/B.

reasons: Mode1 makes the prominent left source cargo roof at 65.25s brighter and more conspicuous without adding believable tidal-port materials or industrial structure.
Mode2 new harbor water recognition produces no RGB>10 pixel differences versus Mode1 at all 3 source frames and therefore did not materially improve water appearance.
At 66.35s only minimal tonal changes; at 68.05s the original rotor and near-miss still dominate but neither shader produces a compelling finished seaport.
More shader modes, names, reflectance coefficients cannot fix absent visibility of original R20 service barge, working quay, foam and crane in those native source frames.
Source research shader is NOT full PBR, there is no human hazard readability or quality certificate.
criticalArtAssessment.positive: The geometry-free shader experiment did produce measurable original-screen tonal changes in mode1 and verified source material IDs/true Blender attributes without any production impact.
criticalArtAssessment.noFalseClaim: Raster difference is not ART acceptance, exact object occupancy, hardware fps or collision certification.

decision.reason: Original research DCC author and original Game never changed during R22; only test scripts, contract, workflow and temporary CI PRIVATE renderer. No formal art adoption.

efficiency.R22Result: Shader edits can alter source camera material tone but do not address fundamental underlying architectural and visibility ART defects. Do not carry these PRIVATE shader variants into source or production.
efficiency.next: R23 quality-first: focus on physically coherent visible source camera architecture/camera-visible water and non-B51-hiding harbor silhouette with small early screenshots BEFORE expensive Blender asset iteration. Avoid repeating changes to unseen assets or additional shader-only modes. Any candidate must show compelling actual source game improvement without sacrificing original red B51, road or true R8J wheel.
